dogecoin.text: @dogecoin_empire They only had middle seats left, but the person in the aisle seat in the new row saw my walking stick and voluntarily gave me her aisle seat and moved to the middle.

@dogecoin_empire I volunteered to switch seats one time when I heard the flight attendants talking to a mother of four about where they could seat her 4 kids. It was obvious that they’d need my aisle seat to keep them all together. You’d have thought I volunteered for a deadly combat mission.
